messages:
Maya: Quick design huddle — looking for a final decision on the trace drilldown export CTA and some a11y follow-ups. Do we go with 'Download trace' or 'Export trace'? Also placement and keyboard behavior. Liam: +1 to making the copy short. We already have 'Download snapshot' in a couple of places so consistency matters. Alex: Engineering note: backend returns a ZIP and triggers a browser download. From an implementation POV both labels map fine, but 'Download' signals the actual behavior. Sam: Accessibility: prefer 'Download trace' — short and clear for screen readers. Important: announce progress and completion via a role=status/aria-live region, and ensure focus handling so keyboard users know the file started. Jordan: Keyboard: after activating the button, keep focus on the button while it shows spinner. If we open a modal for options, trap focus in the modal. If it’s an immediate download, do not move focus away. Maya: Microcopy options I sketched: 1) "Download trace" 2) "Export trace (ZIP)" 3) "Generate trace file". Also thinking about primary vs secondary CTA: primary = immediate download, secondary = export options. Liam: I lean toward 1) 'Download trace' as primary and a small kebab for 'Export options' if users want advanced formats. Alex: Implementation details — live region snippet and button attrs. Example:```html
``` Sam: Note: don't put aria-live on the button itself — it won't be announced reliably. Use a separate role/status element and update its text programmatically: 'Preparing download...', 'Download ready'. Also ensure the success message is dismissible and focusable for keyboard users if needed. Jordan: Copy-to-clipboard for correlation IDs: add a small icon button with aria-label='Copy correlation ID'. Truncate in UI (first+last 6 chars) but expose full ID to SRs via offscreen text. Example:```html abcd...1234 Full correlation id: abcd5678efgh9012ijkl ``` Maya: Design question — where to place primary CTA? Current drilldown toolbar is top-right. Proposal: keep primary 'Download trace' at the top-right, visually prominent, with 'Export options' inside the kebab menu to its left. Keyboard order must follow visual order. Liam: Agreed. Also please add small helper text when hover/focus: 'Includes spans, logs, and attachments — ZIP ~ 2MB'. Alex: I'll add a tiny tooltip component and wire the live region. I'll also ensure the button has a visible focus ring and keyboard target size >= 44px. Sam: Accessibility checklist for this change: 1) role=status aria-live updates for progress + completion 2) aria-labels for copy/download buttons 3) visible focus styles and 44px touch target 4) provide full ID text to screen readers 5) keyboard trapping for modals. I'll run an a11y audit after implementation. Jordan: I'll open two tickets: one for focus/live-region implementation (@alex), one for copy-to-clipboard pattern and tests (@sam + @alex). Maya: Action items summary: Maya — update Figma and final copy; Alex — implement component, live region, tooltip, tests (ETA: Fri EOD); Sam — a11y review and test cases (ETA: Mon); Jordan — create tickets and QA checklist. Liam: Sounds good. Minor nit: ensure color contrast on the download CTA meets 4.5:1. Alex: Will check contrast and add focus outline color var. Maya: Thanks all. I'll close this thread once I push the Figma updates and link tickets. :thumbsup:
